name: connect-strategies-snowflake-create
description: What: Make sure the Snowflake export table exists with a primary key, delete these strategies when present, then create and enable 'Strategy Snowflake Export' and 'Strategy Snowflake Import' on the Main instance. Run by the Snowflake prepares only, so this provider never blocks another. Why: A building block of the Connect pack; a test, setup or schedule workload runs it so its steps exist once. When: Never run directly once the pack is tested; its parents run it. Running it alone is safe only when its own Needs are met. Needs: reference values: connect/urls:ConnectBaseUrl. Success: Every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Run connect-preflight first; then open the first failed step, whose If it fails text names what to check.

inline.description: What: Create {{RemoteSchemaName}}.{{RemoteTableName}} when it does not exist (an existing table and its records are kept), shaped like QA's {{RemoteShapeTableName}}, then add its primary key on {{ExportKeyColumn}} when it has none (Connect refuses an export table without one). Why: Does work no single built-in step does (several calls, waits or checks in one place) and stops at the first problem. Success: The script finishes without an error; its output lines say what it did. If it fails: Read the last output line and the error text: the script names the value, server or record it could not handle.

What: Import 'Strategy Snowflake Export': PDataSourceImport <-> CONNEX_TEST.PDATASNOWFLAKEEXPORT via 'Service Configuration Snowflake'. Name-only artifact (template: QA snowflake-export). Why: Drives Connect (strategies, service configurations, batches) through its REST API for ''. Success: Connect accepts the Import call with an expected status code. If it fails: Check the Connect address (connect/urls:ConnectBaseUrl) answers and the Connect API key works; 400 or 409 usually means the object already exists or the artifact does not fit this Profisee release.
